REQ-TIED_AS_OPERATED_BASELINE.name: As-operated baseline (RDB phases 0–7 vs VRAI)
REQ-TIED_AS_OPERATED_BASELINE.description: TIED enrolls runbook phases 0–7 as an as-operated view at control boundaries, distinct from tied-project VRAI. Checklist facet as_operated_baseline supports follow_up_only (default) or active snapshot enforcement.

rationale.why: Operators need a monitored as-operated baseline during and after implementation; dogfood proved RDB 0–7 without normative TIED gates.
problems_solved: VRAI mistaken for production boundary reality
No machine-checkable snapshot before composition or verification
RDB dogfood evidence not LEAP'd into methodology
benefits: Inherited registry shapes from store dogfood

satisfaction_criteria.criterion: facet mode follow_up_only default; active enforces snapshots.
Snapshot-A minimums at composition-integration when active.
Snapshot-B G-0–G-7,G-9 before verification-gate when active.
RDB rows do not auto-become REQ; BFIE default report_only.
checklist-validator tests cover both modes and both slugs.
